title: Anyone can sign in to another person’s account
description: Anyone can use an unverified email address to sign in to another person’s account, so they can access that person’s private data.

title: Anyone can expose another guest's saved memories
description: Anyone can make chat use another guest's saved memories, so personal details may be disclosed in replies.

title: Anyone can make checkout show a false payment success
description: Anyone can make checkout show that a payment succeeded when it did not, which could mislead customers about their purchase.

title: Anyone can use your WaveSpeed video account
description: Anyone who obtains the published database migration can use your video provider account, so you may face unauthorized charges and loss of access.

title: Anyone can claim the provider-key administrator role
description: Anyone can become the first provider-key administrator, so they can add, deactivate, or delete credentials used by your services.

title: Image editing fetches caller-chosen URLs
description: A caller supplies reference-image URLs that the edge function fetches and forwards without constraining their destinations.

title: Video generation fetches caller-chosen frame URLs
description: A video request supplies a start-frame URL that the edge function fetches and forwards without constraining its destination.

title: Anyone can add credits to any account
description: Anyone can add credits to any account without paying, so your paid features can be used without revenue.

title: Anyone can add credits to any account
description: Anyone can add credits to any account without paying, so your paid features can be used without revenue.

title: Caller text becomes system-level model instructions
description: Request.customSystem is appended to server-authored system text and sent to the model in a system-role message.

title: Anyone can control the chat model’s instructions
description: Anyone can change the chat model’s instructions or message roles, so its answers can be manipulated into ignoring your intended behavior.

title: Anyone can disrupt an integration connection
description: Anyone can make an integration connection appear to fail with a message they choose, so users may be unable to finish connecting an app.

title: Anyone can guess public chat links
description: Anyone can guess a public chat link and read its conversation, so private messages may be exposed.

title: Caller controls the chat model's system instructions
description: Anyone can supply system instructions and message roles to the chat model.
